Title: Relates to exempting 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions
Summary: Exempts 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to exempting 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions
